sessions.text:
User: I write a lot of project updates and want to set some ground rules for your replies.
Assistant: Sure. What should I know?
User: I prefer detailed, multi-paragraph answers by default. Also, always write dates in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Assistant: Got it. Detailed answers by default, and dates in ISO format.
User: Perfect. That's all for now.

User: I've just taken over Project Helios, a warehouse automation rollout.
Assistant: Congratulations. How do you want me to help with it?
User: For Project Helios, when writing for executives, keep it to a three-line summary because they rarely read past the top.
Assistant: Understood. For Project Helios, executive updates get a three-line summary.
User: Thanks. Talk next time.
